title: Dimensions of non-insulated terminal tags for electronic equipment, Part 8: Type 8
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11162 (PART 8)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Dimensions of non-insulated terminal tags for electronic equipment, Part 8: Type 8.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Cold rolled brass sheet, strip and foil

clause_3_terminology: insulated terminal tags for electronic equipment

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
